source.agency: Shenzhen Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau
source.noticeTitle: 深圳市规划和自然资源局关于提供地籍图公众查询服务的通告
source.evidence: The official viewer and notice describe a public cadastral-map query service for Shenzhen (excluding Shenshan). The viewer exposes the LAND_CERTAIN ArcGIS service. The service metadata requires the public client key shipped by the viewer JavaScript; the adapter obtains it from the fixed public script in memory and sends it only to the fixed layer endpoint. The viewer's personal-information agreement was left unchecked and no user identity was submitted.

queryContract.spatialRead: ArcGIS returnCountOnly, returnIdsOnly, then exact objectIds feature reads; no offset pagination
queryContract.exactRead: PARCEL_NO IN (...) translated to count, object-ID manifest, exact object-ID geometry batches
responseValidation: count equals unique object-ID manifest size
all exact object-ID batches complete without transfer-limit truncation
all returned feature IDs belong to requested batches
duplicate native IDs and conflicting object-ID/geometry mappings are rejected
invalid polygon rings or non-finite coordinates are rejected by the parcel adapter

boundedVerification.grid: 3x3 at the center plus the same 3x3 grid shifted by +0.004 degrees in longitude and latitude
boundedVerification.geometryValidation: All bounded polygons had finite coordinates, closed rings, and intersected their query cells.
boundedVerification.http: All bounded/count/manifest/exact-read responses returned successful HTTP responses through the source client.

catalogueAttribution: Shenzhen public cadastral-map query service; source notice and viewer linked above. Use is subject to the source's published notices. The public viewer displays an agreement concerning use of personal information; it was not accepted or bypassed for this anonymous bounded source assessment.
dataRetention: Only counts, query parameters, schema fields, completion checks, and aggregate validation outcomes are retained here. No parcel geometries, parcel identifiers, public client key, or owner/address fields are persisted.
